title: Person-Centric Annotations of LAION-400M: Auditing Bias and Its Transfer to Models

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating dataset images with perceived gender using MLLMs to evaluate demographic distributions, analyzing co-occurrences with crime words and negative sentiment, discovering intersectional topic associations via Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), and measuring linear bias transfer to CLIP and Stable Diffusion models using social category prompts.

Classifying perceived race/ethnicity in dataset images using MLLMs to audit representation imbalances, measuring disproportionate associations with crime-related keywords and negative sentiment, and analyzing intersectional topic representations using SAEs.
Counting country name mentions and their synonyms in dataset alt-text captions to quantify the overrepresentation of industrialized, English-speaking nations compared to the Global South.
